title: Construct a P104 dyadic tensor code and price repeated Gram stages
body:
This changes the representation premise behind #3961: one invertible Gaussian-dyadic code retains all 21,632 data fields across both logical P104 Gram stages. With `U=[[I,B],[0,I]]`, `L=U_r U_c^-t` and `(Xhat,Yhat)=(LX,L^-tY)`, the transformed coefficients are `P_r M_c` and `M_r P_c`, `M=UU^t`. The code is shared at the internal boundary, retains the kernel payload, and restores fixed X/Y slots without division by 13.

The package supplies literal scalar words with entry and exit charged. Against its specified uncoded reference, two repeated **uncorrected Gram pairs** save 110,592 unit additions and 33,280 halves/restoring doubles each; one pair loses 104,448 additions. This is a common-chart protocol comparison, not a full-caller or native-cost improvement. Other uncoded factorizations may amortize too.

The full identity caller still requires coded coefficients `N_r M_c` and `M_r N_c`, `N=M^-1`. Each omitted side term has rational rank 10,816; that is algebraic rank, not a native tariff lower bound. The proof derives the ordered physical chart conjugates and records the unresolved native code, actual repeated consumer, identity completion, helpers, ownership, routing, precision and complete gate. No actual adjacent completed P104 pair is claimed and no selected-frontier files change.

A separate ring obstruction distinguishes this construction from a free spectral split: `A tensor A` has rank 64 modulo 13, while the proposed product `169 P_r P_c` vanishes. Thus bank-separate invertible Gaussian-dyadic codes cannot realize that particular normalization. General bank-mixing codes and changed alphabets are outside the obstruction.

Validation: registered Python3.12 replay; source-authenticated P104 reconstruction and full scalar word; independent Fraction evaluation on 50 basis columns with 7 ordering/negative controls; seven optimized tests covering typed/duplicate receipts, corrupt/missing sources, altered donor restoration and readonly Git-free replay. At exact head `a8a1d744811cd7d1f9c43ec7ccbae85ef9695b61`, the byte/history preflight passes 14 declared files, registered replay passes, and official export/check passes. All three commands also pass under `-I -O -B` from a Git-free export with empty PATH and all 15 files read-only; their bytes and modes remain unchanged. Export SHA256: `7ee61e6477be20673fdc7c6ba8795c9c9606c633fe8e4be2948d763ad4ee7de8`. Hosted CI remains a separate pending check.

Scope: 11 new files under `research/p104-tensor-code/`, based on canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; all three executable inputs are already on main. Outcome is partial. Next work must pin an actual repeated physical consumer and price the explicit `N-P` side maps before expanding native construction. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954#issuecomment-6262365386 . Live overlap refresh covered all 676 open PR bodies including drafts; main remained unchanged at publication checkpoint.

Credit: Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and coordinated agent review. #3961 supplies the preceding mismatch and reused source-authentication/root construction; #3882/#3940/#3943/#3954 retain the caller lineage. ToikY owns #3956's adapter comparison and #3966's phase gauge, context only. Original P104/E8/native/compiler sources retain the credits listed in README. No pending PR object is needed for replay.
